description.value:
A wave of enormous needles blasts outward from you in a 30-foot cone. Creatures in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take 6d6 piercing damage, and needles are embedded all over their body. On a success, creatures take half as much damage. A creature with needles embedded in them takes 2d6 piercing damage the first time they move on each of their turns.

A creature can use their action to remove the needles, or can make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of their turns, shedding the needles on a success. The needles fall out naturally after 1 minute.

At higher levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of Level 5 or higher, it deals an additional 2d6 damage initially for each slot level above 4th.
